dedupe_keys.name: fire dynamics simulator fds and smokeview nist

description: Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS) is NIST's large-eddy simulation code for low-speed flows, focused on smoke and heat transport from fires, and Smokeview displays the output of FDS and of CFAST simulations. The site offers downloads, documentation, a discussion forum, issue tracker and wiki, third-party interfaces and training, road maps for future research, and publicly available reports for the experimental datasets in the FDS Validation Guide. The FDS+Evac evacuation module, developed by VTT in Finland, is no longer supported after FDS 6.7.7. Coverage: generic. Access: free downloads for Windows, macOS and Linux and source code. Licence: public domain, as a U.S. government work not subject to copyright. Caveats: results depend on grid resolution and the modeller's inputs, and evacuation now needs separate tools. Simulation uses: smoke spread and tenability in buildings, tunnels and facilities for fire safety design and emergency planning. Related records: CONTAM, the EXODUS evacuation model and Pathfinder.
